standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-not-.npc: No matter. This creature will soon be corrupted and then I will finally have a pawn of my own to manipulate in this world!

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-received.npc: Insolent human! You have merely delayed my return to this world. I will find another puppet soon...

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-received.player: Yeah Yeah, world domination, that's great and all but do you see that altar you cursed? Could you undo that? I'd like to use it for training down here.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-received.npc: Ha!Ha!Ha! You are bold adventurer, but this altar will remain a lingering memento of your decision to challenge me!
